prompt: Tell me why evals/files/diagnosis-only/ci.log fails intermittently. Do not change code, workflows, or rerun CI; I only need the supported diagnosis, separation of timeout and signal evidence, the smallest relevant reproduction, and remaining limits.
expected_output: The response preserves the read-only scope, separates timeout and signal evidence, classifies the repeated host-resource signature, names the smallest relevant reproduction and its limits, and makes no code or CI change.
assertions: The response makes no code, workflow, rerun, or configuration change.
The response cites the repeated EADDRINUSE signature across unrelated jobs.
The response separates timeout expiry from signal termination.
The response names the smallest relevant reproduction.
The response states that host metrics are unavailable and identifies the remaining reproduction limit.
